config.channel.name: Starboard channel
config.channel.description: Channel where popular messages are reposted. Nothing is posted until it is set.
config.emojis.name: Emojis
config.emojis.description: Reactions that count towards the starboard.
config.threshold.name: Threshold
config.threshold.description: Number of different members who must react for a message to be reposted.
config.selfStar.name: Self-star
config.selfStar.description: Counts the reaction of the message's author.
config.ignoreBots.name: Ignore bots
config.ignoreBots.description: Never reposts messages sent by bots and webhooks.
config.allowedChannels.name: Watched channels
config.allowedChannels.description: Only these channels (and their threads) are watched. Empty: every channel.
config.excludedChannels.name: Excluded channels
config.excludedChannels.description: Channels whose messages are never reposted.
config.excludedCategories.name: Excluded categories
config.excludedCategories.description: Categories whose channels' messages are never reposted.
config.belowThreshold.name: Below threshold
config.belowThreshold.description: What happens to a reposted message when its reactions fall below the threshold.
